answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the relic of a task receipt, and the prism is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
